title: EEVblog #1333 - Nuclear Diamond Self-Charging Battery DEBUNKED!
summary: Dave Jones of EEVblog debunks the marketing claims of the self-charging nano nuclear diamond battery from NDB Inc. He argues it is no better than existing 100uW betavoltaic batteries, with an added graphene supercapacitor.
why: Repeatedly linked under hype stories about nuclear diamond batteries as the definitive debunk.

quote.text: eevblog had a good video about this product
